scope_interpretation: Somente a rota / e os elementos header, Filter Bar, cards, tendência, ranking e footer. Rotas /ubs, /indicadores e /sobre não bloqueiam TASK-055.

evidence_availability.webauditmcp: not required by TASK-055 and not exposed in this session
evidence_availability.comparison_method: DOM/CSS/React source inspection against pg1, Design System and SPEC, automated gates, and HTTP smoke of /

TASK-049.evidence: Header declares h-16 (64px), desktop px-6 (24px), logo 44x24, title text-lg/font-bold, desktop nav gap-6 (24px), active aria-current/color/font/underline, and three links remain rendered at mobile width.

TASK-050.evidence: globals.css defines #fafafa background, #004B87 primary, hover/light tokens; page/dashboard source supplies max-width 1280 canvas and preserves Filter Bar → cards → trend → ranking sequence; section headings are text-lg/font-semibold and card values text-3xl/font-bold.

TASK-051.evidence: Filter Bar is flex-wrap/items-center with border-bottom, bg-white, px-6 py-4 and gap-4. UBS and period labels are sr-only, therefore do not occupy a visual line; their select triggers are siblings in the desktop flex row with 200px/180px widths. Limpar is present and disabled in default state; disabled button cannot invoke callback. At mobile wrappers/selects are w-full with min-h-11 and flex wrapping.

TASK-052.evidence: Four-card grid is 1/2/4 columns with lg gap 24px; each card is h-[245px], p-6, rounded-lg (8px), shadow-sm, border-l-4 semaphore styling; mobile is one fluid column and content is overflow-hidden without clipping the required visible anatomy.

TASK-053.evidence: Trend is one bordered rounded-xl shadow-sm p-6 card. Heading, indicator select and short summary are in the same section; sm+ layout is a row and mobile wraps. Recharts source has exactly one Line, ReferenceLine and Tooltip, responsive 250/280/300px heights, visible Valor/Meta legend and accessible description. Indicator selection is isolated in dashboard state.

TASK-054.evidence: Ranking is white bordered rounded-xl shadow-sm p-6 card with 16px internal gap, required title and municipal note. Table has 15 runtime rows from calculateRanking(ubs, periodRecords, indicators), 48px rows, links, semantic headers and 600px min-width horizontal overflow.

footer.evidence: Footer has contentinfo role, zinc-50 surface, border, 24px padding, simulated-data disclaimer, CNES/e-SUS AB/DATASUS sources and Protótipo v1.0 — Saúde Itapira; no personal promotion.

residual_differences: Screenshots and computed-browser measurements were unavailable; exact pixel geometry and mobile clipping were assessed from explicit responsive DOM/CSS only.
The .pen uses Inter as a placeholder while production uses Geist Sans as required by DESIGN_SYSTEM; intentional documented substitution.
Production values are real local data and were not compared to demonstrative .pen values.
Other application routes were intentionally excluded from TASK-055 scope per acceptance clarification.

previous_failure.resolution: The prior Filter Bar finding incorrectly treated sr-only labels and wrapper flex direction as a visual desktop line. Effective layout has invisible labels and sibling selects in the desktop flex row; out-of-scope route smoke findings were removed.
